Write a descriptive, fictional, imaginative screenplay of a 127 year old man receiving the world record for oldest human to ever live. Later that night, in bed, he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth, \"Quantum Immortality\" he then proceeds to have a mental breakdown.\n Write the entire response in title case (capitalize the first letter of every major word).assistant
response:
**THE RECORD BREAKER**

FADE IN:

INT. WORLD RECORD OFFICE - DAY

We see a crowded room filled with officials, reporters, and camera crews. At the center of it all is 127-year-old JASPER JENKINS, a frail but determined man with a twinkle in his eye. He is escorted to a podium, where a plaque awaits him.

OFFICIAL
Ladies And Gentlemen, It Is Our Pleasure To Present The World Record For Oldest Human To Ever Live, Held By The Incomparable Jasper Jenkins!

Jasper's eyes light up as he accepts the plaque, a beaming smile spreading across his face. The crowd erupts in applause as he takes a bow.

CUT TO:

INT. JASPER'S BEDROOM - NIGHT

Jasper lies in bed, the plaque from earlier proudly displayed on his nightstand. He gazes at it wistfully, lost in thought. Suddenly, his eyes glaze over as he recalls a theory he read on the internet in his youth.

JASPER (V.O)
Quantum Immortality... I Remember Reading About It Online. The Idea That Our Reality Is Just One Of Many Parallel Universes, And That We're All Just Living In A Simulation...

As Jasper's mind wanders, his expression changes from nostalgia to unease. His eyes dart back and forth, his breathing quickening.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
What If It's True? What If I'm Not Really Dead? What If I'm Just... Stuck In This Simulation?

Jasper's voice rises, his words becoming a frantic whisper.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'VE BEEN TRYING TO ESCAPE FOR SO LONG, BUT I DON'T KNOW HOW. I DON'T KNOW IF IT'S EVEN POSSIBLE.

The camera zooms in on Jasper's face, his eyes wild with fear and desperation.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'VE BEEN LIVING IN A WORLD THAT'S NOT REAL. A WORLD THAT'S BEEN MANIPULATED BY SOMEONE OR SOMETHING ELSE.

Jasper's body begins to shake, his eyes rolling back in his head. He screams, his voice echoing through the room.

JASPER (V.O) (CONT'D)
I'M NOT ALIVE! I'M JUST A SIMULATION! I'M JUST A... A... A...

The camera cuts to black as Jasper's screams fade into the darkness, his mind shattered by the weight of his own theory.

FADE TO BLACK.
